course.title: General Science & Scientific Inquiry
course.description: Comprehensive multidisciplinary science question bank covering Biology, Physics, Earth Sciences, Chemistry, and Scientific Method.

topics.name: Cell Biology & Genetics
topics.description: Prokaryotes vs eukaryotes, DNA, genes, protein synthesis, and cellular structures.

topics.name: Plant Biology & Photosynthesis
topics.description: Light reactions, chloroplasts, leaf anatomy, transpiration, and botanical reproduction.

topics.name: Ecology & Ecosystems
topics.description: Food chains, trophic levels, adaptations, symbiosis, population dynamics, and biomes.

topics.name: Human Body & Living Systems
topics.description: Circulation, respiration, digestion, nerves, organs, and physiological homeostasis.

topics.name: Forces, Motion & Dynamics
topics.description: Newtonian mechanics, speed, acceleration, gravity, friction, and momentum.

topics.name: Energy, Work & Heat
topics.description: Kinetic and potential energy, heat transfer, thermal dynamics, and energy conservation.

topics.name: Electricity, Magnetism & Circuits
topics.description: Current, voltage, series and parallel circuits, magnetic fields, and electromagnetism.

topics.name: Waves, Light & Sound
topics.description: Wavelength, reflection, refraction, lenses, auditory vibrations, and the electromagnetic spectrum.

topics.name: Astronomy & Solar System
topics.description: Planetary orbits, lunar phases, meteorite impacts, stars, eclipses, and space exploration.

topics.name: Geology, Rocks & Earth History
topics.description: Rock formation, mineral properties, plate tectonics, earthquakes, volcanoes, and the fossil record.

topics.name: Weather, Atmosphere & Water Cycle
topics.description: Troposphere and atmospheric layers, precipitation, cloud formation, and meteorological phenomena.

topics.name: Atomic Structure & Elements
topics.description: Subatomic particles, electron shells, isotopes, and the periodic table of elements.

topics.name: Chemical Reactions & Changes
topics.description: Endothermic/exothermic reactions, conservation of mass, oxidation, acids, bases, and pH.

topics.name: States & Properties of Matter
topics.description: Phase transitions, density, solubility, mixtures, physical properties, and solutions.

topics.name: Scientific Method & Experiments
topics.description: Hypotheses, independent/dependent variables, controls, data analysis, and laboratory precision.

topics.name: Engineering & Technology
topics.description: Engineering design process, structural integrity, sustainable technology, and applied mechanics.
